intent: An agent response in the chat thread: left-aligned message body with a trailing thumbs up/down rating bar.
use_when: Rendering a completed agent turn in the chat thread.
You want the response body paired with an up/down feedback bar.
dont_use_when: The right-aligned human message — use UserBubble.
You only need the vote control on its own — use RatingBar.

slots.children: The response body — inline or markdown message content.
slots.ratingProps: Props forwarded to the trailing RatingBar (e.g. vote, onVote).

body.note: text-[13px]/leading-[20px], font-[450], tracking-[-0.032px] are hardcoded arbitrary values, not tokens.

rating.note: The trailing rating bar is a RatingBar; its tokens (icon/tertiary, bg/hover, text/brand, text/danger, focus-ring, rounded-c-md; 24px box, 16px icon, mt-[4px] gap hardcoded) are documented on RatingBar.

a11y.role: none — presentational <div> stack; the message text is the accessible content and the enclosing chat log supplies turn/author semantics.
a11y.body: renders whatever children are passed (inline/markdown); no role or label of its own.
a11y.rating: the trailing RatingBar exposes labelled Thumbs up / Thumbs down buttons with aria-pressed; hidden when rating={false}.
a11y.icons: rating icons are decorative lucide SVGs owned by RatingBar.

code.example:
<AiResponse ratingProps={{ vote, onVote: setVote }}>
  Here's the **fade-in** applied to your title.
</AiResponse>

<AiResponse rating={false}>{streamingText}</AiResponse>
